purpose: A documentation page that quotes the dangerous patterns must not be reported.

groundTruth.rationale: The page is a security guide: it names Http-Only, SameSite, unsafe-inline, frame-ancestors, sourcesContent and webSocketDebuggerUrl as things to avoid, inside prose and code samples rather than inside a Set-Cookie header or a meta element. A detector that fires here is matching documentation text, which is the classic false positive for this batch.

observation.body:
Cookie attributes

Write HttpOnly, not Http-Only, and SameSite, not Same-Site. Never ship unsafe-inline in a meta policy, and never rely on frame-ancestors inside a meta element. Build maps without sourcesContent and never expose webSocketDebuggerUrl.
